title: The Anatomy of a 1-Person Company
caption:
The smallest real business is one person + systems. 🤝

What a 1-person company actually looks like in 2026:

1️⃣ One offer, priced for outcomes (not hours)
2️⃣ A pipeline that runs without you chasing
3️⃣ Delivery documented as SOPs + AI agents
4️⃣ One distribution channel, done daily
5️⃣ Numbers reviewed every single week

Headcount is not a goal. Leverage is. ⚡

Save this 📌 — this is the blueprint.
